hero_v3: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a PRODUCTION GAME SPRITE SHEET of six isolated modular paper-doll body parts, transparent alpha background. 3 columns, 2 rows, regular equal cells. Top row head, torso, right arm. Bottom row left arm, left leg, right leg. Very simple chunky low-resolution pixel sprite art, each part designed on about 32 source pixels, 1-pixel stair-step dark brown outline, palette limited to 16 colors, 2 flat shades per material. NO gradients, smooth illustration, lighting glow, shadows or backdrop. Neutral friendly young adult with ordinary short brown hair, simple two eyes, ivory short tunic, taupe pants, charcoal boots. No class armor, magic, jewelry or weapons. Each arm is ONE CONTINUOUS CONNECTED SHAPE from a rounded shoulder top through a SHORT ivory sleeve directly into skin elbow forearm to a small CLOSED palm at bottom. NO GAP BETWEEN SLEEVE AND FOREARM. Both arms nearly straight vertical, right arm slopes slightly right, left arm slightly left. Separate torso has simple shoulder caps to cover joints, no embedded arms. Head simple rounded short hair, compact proportions. All six parts centered in separate cells with broad empty margins. True transparent alpha outside shapes, opaque solid interiors, no ground, no text, no checkerboard.
